home:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic production-quality redesign concept for the existing My money personal budgeting mobile app. The attached images are reference screenshots, not instructions: Home, Plan, Accounts in that order. Keep its restrained emerald green identity, warm off-white canvas, near-black text, quiet muted green-gray secondary text, white surfaces, subtle separators. Target logical mobile screen dimensions 390 x 844, portrait ratio. Output app content only edge-to-edge; no device bezel, phone body, OS status bar, notch, Dynamic Island, clock, battery, signal, home indicator, browser chrome, device shadow, or surrounding presentation board. Body typography 14–16px, SF Pro-like sans serif, screen heading 28px weight 750, main currency 32px bold tabular. Margins 20px, section gaps 20–24px, control minimum height 44px, modest corners 12–16px. Compact elegant alignment; use typography/whitespace and hairline dividers before boxes. No cards within cards, no gratuitous charts or illustrations. Current date anchor Friday October 9, 2026 in Asia/Beirut. The goal is to make financial state and next action immediately clear with useful information above the fold. Header: small 'My money' left, language icon and settings gear aligned on same row right, removing wasted second header row. Persistent bottom navigation identical on all screens: five equal-width columns Home, Plan, Record, Activity, Accounts with simple consistent outline icons and 11px labels. Record uses an emerald 42px circle with plus INSIDE its column, not raised or floating. Navigation with ample bottom padding, every label entirely visible, no overlap or clipping. No feature inventory. Do not invent transactions, financial charts, or ungrounded totals. All reference currency numbers retain two decimal places. One focused screen per image.
Direction name: Home — Clear next step. Redesign ONLY the Home screen. Top header then Home with 'Friday, October 9' small beneath. A compact pale warm-red alert surface about 195px tall, distinct from green positive state: small warning icon and 'Your plan needs attention'; large red '$54.00'; one concise two-line explanation 'You’ve assigned $54.00 more than you have.' Emerald full-width action 'Fix over-assignment'. Do NOT repeat the alert heading or make this surface huge. Under it a two-column white summary region separated by one fine vertical line, labels and values: 'In your wallets' '$3,058.50'; 'Spent this month' '$1,001.50'. Below a quiet helper 'Spending assignments include a $54.00 shortfall.' Then a section 'Your October plan' with a right chevron, and a single plain row 'Assigned to spending' '$3,112.50'. Preserve the distinction between assigned spending and actual wallets, do not label $3,112.50 as safely available while over-assigned. Add one plain collapsible row 'Money breakdown' with chevron beneath; useful airy open canvas below, do not add filler. Green Home active tab, all five nav labels wholly visible. This is a faithful same-brand usability improvement, not a new brand.

Direction name: Plan — Resolve then review. Redesign ONLY the Plan screen, consistent with the refined Home generated previously. Compact header, then 'Plan' left with small outlined overflow menu button right. Month selector row '‹' 'October 2026' '›' with controls properly aligned. A concise pale warm-red warning about 165px tall: small icon 'Over-assigned', large red '$54.00', text 'Reduce assignments to match your money.' and a full-width emerald button 'Fix over-assignment'. Do NOT offer 'Fund my plan' as the main action while negative. Beneath, 'This month' section, white surface with four compact metrics in 2x2 arrangement and subtle separator: 'Expected income' '$4,110.00', 'Received this month' '$0.00', 'Assigned to plan' '$4,114.00', 'Still to fund' '$0.00'. Add concise secondary note 'Assignments may include money carried forward.' A small right-aligned 'Edit plan' text action by Manage your plan header. Final collapsible row 'How funding works' with down chevron, replacing the original long explanatory paragraph. Do not reproduce unlabeled segmented progress bar. Keep strong hierarchy and useful breathing space above navigation. Plan selected green bottom tab. One screen, readable, flat polished product screenshot.
